guard: the connector waits through late Jcode registry writes and signals only PIDs carrying the immutable launch-bound identity captured from the bridge this host spawned; stale foreign records are skipped on startup failure and graceful stop
_note: assert-and-die suite: HIGH-1 is mark 8 and HIGH-2 startup is mark 11; each mutation names the exact assertion it must redden.
why: The SDK reads mutable servers.json and group-signals the PID without proving ownership. A stale
record therefore kills an unrelated process tree before connector verification can run. The host
now removes the SDK exit hook, captures a random launch-bound environment identity plus immutable
process start tokens, and owns teardown itself. Registry PIDs must match that captured identity or
they are skipped. The bridge is stopped first; a settle scan catches a record written only after
bridge death, and unrecorded processes already captured from this launch are still reaped exactly.

mutations.expectRed: late records are not orphaned after the connector returns (#HIGH-1)

mutations.expectRed: stale foreign record never kills the unrelated process or child on startup failure (#HIGH-2)
